canada.title: Murder charges laid in Regina woman's death
canada.summary: Police have charged Destinee Villebrun, 41, and a 17-year old with second-degree murder in the death of Rebecca Autumn (Wilson) Mathieson, 37, who was found seriously injured in an alley on Aug. 14 and died on Aug. 30.

canada.title: New details emerge in death of 4-year-old Inuk girl in care of Montreal youth protection
canada.summary: Quebec’s health authority has launched a major investigation into the care of Montreal's English youth protection system after three deaths of children in their care in March 2026.

canada.title: Tumbler Ridge shooting survivor Maya Gebala being released from hospital, father says
canada.summary: A 13-year-old girl who was severely injured in the Tumbler Ridge mass shooting is being released from hospital after nearly nine months of uncertain recovery, her father says.

canada.title: Don’t fall back this weekend, province says
canada.summary: The province is reminding Manitobans not to turn clocks back an hour, with the move to permanent daylight time.

canada.title: A timeline of key events in the Regis Korchinski-Paquet case
canada.summary: A coroner’s inquest is scheduled to start Tuesday in the case of Regis Korchinski-Paquet, a 29-year-old Afro-Indigenous woman who fell from a Toronto highrise balcony while police were in her home in 2020.

canada.title: N.S. electricity grid needs new equipment, upgrades to handle AI data centre, studies find
canada.summary: It would cost tens of millions of dollars, or more, in new equipment and upgrades, but Nova Scotia’s electricity grid can theoretically handle a massive AI data centre project — according to newly released documents from the grid operator.

canada.title: Sheilagh O'Leary back in House of Assembly following Wednesday ejection
canada.summary: NDP MHA Sheilagh O'Leary was ordered from the House of Assembly on Wednesday afternoon after refusing to retract a comment she made about the minister responsible for Newfoundland and Labrador Housing, Chris Tibbs. O'Leary said Tibbs spoke "untruths," in language considered unparliamentary. O'Leary told reporters she is standing on principle. At this point it's unclear how long she will be unable to address the legislature.

canada.title: Proposed Alberta bill requires daycares to quickly inform parents about serious incidents
canada.summary: The Alberta government is proposing amendments to the Early Learning and Childcare Act to improve parental notification when a serious incident happens at a daycare.

canada.title: Montreal police explain day-long delay in dismantling unit accused of misconduct
canada.summary: A 16-member patrol unit remained armed and active for nearly a full day after investigations secured enough evidence to take action against officers accused of criminal misconduct.

canada.title: Woman who helped get tenants out of burning Shediac apartment building says they're in shock
canada.summary: A blackened apartment building in Shediac was still smoking several hours after a fire broke out early Thursday morning, displacing all residents of the 36-unit building.

canada.title: Ottawa quietly abandoned its promise to end thermal coal exports, auditor finds
canada.summary: A report from the federal auditor general published Thursday reveals Environment and Climate Change Canada quietly gave up on its plans to end thermal coal exports years ago without notifying the public and without record of being directed a do so.

canada.title: Officer shot in Belleville synagogue attack released from hospital
canada.summary: Police in Belleville say an officer who was shot on Yom Kippur while protecting a synagogue full of worshippers from an armed attacker has been released from the hospital.

canada.title: Kevin Falcon steps down as head of now-deregistered B.C. United party
canada.summary: Former British Columbia opposition leader Kevin Falcon has stepped down as head of the deregistered B.C. United party, two years after it folded its 2024 election campaign to support the provincial Conservatives.

canada.title: High-risk sex offender released, expected to live in Winnipeg
canada.summary: Convicted sex offender Douglas Wayne Bowman, 62, has been released after a lengthy prison sentence, and Winnipeg police are warning the public he is considered a high risk to reoffend.
